algorithm: Return the maximum value as the diameter
constraints: Graph must be simple undirected unweighted
Diameter is defined as the maximum eccentricity
edge_cases: Graph with a single vertex (n=1) has diameter 0
Graph with all vertices isolated has diameter 0
Graph with two connected vertices has diameter 1
inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n
output: integer: maximum eccentricity (diameter) of the graph
purpose: Compute the diameter of a simple undirected unweighted graph
